match.description: Ija Ominira is the cinematic transposition of a novel by Faleti. It is the story of a tyrannical and cruel king who is killed by his people, now tired and exasperated.

The story follows a man named Austin who seeks to upgrade his social status by pursuing and romancing a woman from a wealthy political family, abandoning true love in pursuit of greed and wealth, only for his ambition to end in heartbreak.

An avid baker who aspires to open up her own bakery is offered the opportunity to make enough money to do so by playing girlfriend to her friend’s boss whose parents are coming into town for the weekend, however his arrogance threatens to ruin the whole deal.

Two friends Cleo (Funke Akindele) and Alice (Queen Nwokoye) live a fake life in the city, they think they are on top of their game till Cleo comes across Shania (Nse Ikpe Etim) who beats them to their game, Cleo becomes anxious to know more about Shania, she traces her and finds out who she really is.

Before a father forbids his child to call him father, then the child might have committed a grievous offense. Senator Ezekiel has two daughters, Nancy and Whitney, the elders being Nancy is rather the black sheep of the humble and wealthy family. Her name is forbidden to be mentioned in the house or anywhere around the Senator. Her younger sister Whitney is not supposed to be anywhere near or have anything to do with her. Watch and find out why a father could actually be heartless towards his daughter. [parts 1-2]

Hitler and his friends set the campus on fire with their robbery, drug dealing and wild antics. George, the son of a general, falls in love with the Wife of Hitler and there is a wild chase in to the Caniball Kingdom.

For their diminutive size, the quest to find love and their history of mischief and pranks strike as distasteful attributes that hampers their efforts and remains a stumbling block. Still convinced and hopeful of success, the inhibiting and unrelenting pursuance to eventually succeed led to crafty and cunning choices. But would they ever succeed or rather resort to extreme methods when all other attempts fail? [parts 1-2]

Ejike Asiegbu plays the role of Anti Christ whom has come according to the scripture to take over the ruler-ship of the earth with the sole mission of dragging so many people as many as possible to Satan before the coming of the one main saviour.

Angelica and Andrew dated for three years before Andrew travelled abroad to Austria. While away, news reaches him of Angelica’s promiscuous lifestyle in the village, prompting him to marry an Austrian woman, Anna, instead. Guided and influenced by her calculating mother, Angelica views relationships as transactional commodities and, through deceptive schemes, sets out to wreck Andrew's new marriage and claim him back for financial gain.

The Ikenga, which belongs to the King of Amanze, is missing therefore the people of Amanze plan to attack the people of Akabo over the missing Ikenga. The king places his daughter as the price for anyone who first finds his Ikenga. The gods have chosen Mgbada and Eneh for the mission, but there seems to be a lot of mischief going on.

There lives a very big Python in the village Ngwuzu, this python keeps killing children, the old and animals in the community…. It has lived and terrorized their community for a very long time… the Elders are fed-up and decided to consult the chief priest about what to do with the python.

The Story of a roadside food vendor who comes across a stranded wealthy man and offered him shelter while he awaits his car mechanic. An attempt to help her out from her life of poverty wrecked his home. Saint Obi, Monalisa Chinda, Oby Edozie.

Mezu discovers he's trapped in a time loop in Nigeria. To his surprise, his colleague Kamsi is in the same predicament. Together with their friends Tobe, Wasiu, and Sola, they must unite to break free.

In 'Win or Lose', a struggling family man living with his family in the ghetto suddenly comes into possession of a winning lottery ticket - and a series of hilarious events unfold as he tries to enjoy his new found status.

Set in a high society secondary school, the story explores the reality of high school finalists while focussing on young and ever cheerful Jidenna Khalil Mbunabo played by Clinton Joshua, who always tried to make everyone happy anyway he can.Treasure in the sky is more of a tragic love story and though it portrayed happy stories in the beginning, the ending was quite emotional thanks to the chain of  tragic events and encounters that followed after.

A raucous village girl is overjoyed when a sophisticated city man who has just returned from America takes interest in her, however he is warned by elders in the village that she is a troublemaker and so she decides to prove to him that she is worth marrying.
Omo Ghetto (Child of the Ghetto) franchise tells the story of twin sisters leading separate lives but are reunited by series of dramatic twists.

A razz village girl who has never left her community is plunged into a sophisticated new world when she goes to university in Lagos. She quickly learns that she must fight to earn respect and become popular.

Ofoma suffers relentless and brutal abuse from his stepfather, Ehis. Ofoma’s mother, Endurance, endures her son’s suffering in silence, unable to confront her husband. Despite the abuse, Ofoma has an unwavering love for baseball. This passion leads to trouble when Ehis wrongly accuses him of stealing money to watch baseball games.
A young man attends a college reunion with a fake girlfriend in an attempt to make his ex jealous.

After her estranged father’s death, Oluchi , an upcoming musician is forced to confront her true self and past mistakes. She reconnects with her daughter through their love for music. However, the echoes from the past spring from every corner, threatening to bring them down.

Mr Coker, a wealthy, talented, and charming artist, falls head over heels in love with Jacqueline, a woman profoundly devoted to her Christian faith and to her fiancé, Victor. Because of her strong beliefs and prior commitment, Coker's repeated declarations of love are completely ignored. However, fate intervenes, bringing them together in a high-stakes business arrangement proposed by the irresistible artist himself, forcing Jacqueline to face a truly critical decision between her faith, her promises, and her heart.

Prince Arinze and Kasie grew up together, sharing a deep passion. However, owing to an inevitable circumstance, they got separated for years. Just at the moment the prince is expected to take a wife, something happened, and that marks the beginning of an unexpected adventure of the heart.

After the humiliation and pain Chinenye and her family went through in the hands of a woman whom they all worked for as maids in her house, favor finally smiled on them as their little sister, Chioma brings joy to the family again

In the sequel to the movie Stolen Kiss, tension mounts as the good for nothing older brother of the Umejesi family, Dan (Van Vicker) fights tooth and nail against his younger brother Victor (Jim Iyke) over the will. Now Victor must take the most unbelievable action to uphold peace in the family hence taking us to a different and more interesting and suspenseful angle of the whole story.
A man sets up an improbably complex revenge after being beaten.
